DOWNTOWN MIssional community

Lunch Ministry

Every Wednesday night starting at 6:30pm our team prepares lunches to be handed out to the community on Thursdays starting at 11:00AM.  We have a specific route we take throughout the neighborhoods and stop by to check in on our friends.

We have been blessed to serve in this ministry for many years and have many God stories to share from our time in the community.

If you are interested in serving in our Downtown Lunch Ministry please use the contact button below.

Learn More

DIamond Hill Community

Over the three plus years of the lunch ministry we’ve been blessed to build some great friendships with Diamond Hill residents, and partner organizations as well (both Lighthouse and The Diamond Hill Community Center). Roughly 100 lunches are delivered to the Diamond Hill Community each week! We are all involved in a dynamic outreach ministry where the catalyst is delivering lunches, but the goal of the ministry is to encourage, pray with, laugh with, cry with, and share the Gospel with those that the Lord puts in our path. Some that we interact with are regulars in the community that we see every week and some we meet for the first time that particular week. We go into the community with open minds and open hearts, while asking the Lord to lead the way.
